contests.title: Saydel Community School District — Measure S: School improvement bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Saydel Community School District in the County of Polk, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $26,900,000 to provide funds to build, furnish, and equip an addition to Cornell Elementary for kindergarten and early childhood education, including a playground and site improvements; to remodel, repair, furnish, and equip Cornell Elementary, Woodside Middle School, and the High School, including HVAC, electrical, and building improvements; for improvements to the High School emergency generator system and sewer line; and to remodel, repair, furnish, and equip athletic facilities, including improvements to the softball concession and restrooms facility, football field turf replacement, and softball and baseball field turf installation?

contests.title: Madrid Community School District — Measure BQ: Junior-senior high school bonds

provenance.quote: Shall the Board of Directors of the Madrid Community School District in the Counties of Boone, Dallas, and Polk, State of Iowa, be authorized to contract indebtedness and issue General Obligation Bonds in an amount not to exceed $4,300,000 to provide funds to build, furnish and equip additions to its existing Junior-Senior High School, including a Career Academy addition, with related remodeling and improvements and site improvements?

measureRecords.whatItDoes: Authorizes up to $26.9 million in general-obligation bonds for an addition at Cornell Elementary for kindergarten and early childhood education, playground and site work, renovations and building systems at Cornell Elementary, Woodside Middle School and the high school, high school generator and sewer work, and athletic facilities and field turf.
Authorizes up to $4.3 million in general-obligation bonds for additions to the existing junior-senior high school, including a Career Academy addition, related renovations and site improvements.
measureRecords.yesMeans: Authorize the junior-senior high school bonds.
